0000.name: Scratch byte $00
desc: Direct-page scratch variable with no fixed meaning. Any routine may use it as a temporary for arithmetic, hitbox
coordinates, loop counters or return values, and its contents do not survive a call to another routine.
The call sites below show what each routine keeps in it; there is nothing shared between them.
Adjacent scratch bytes are often paired as a 16-bit value or, with $0000-$0002, as a 24-bit pointer used by
indirect long addressing (for example the data pointer passed to the SPC700 upload routine).
